title: Two thirds of everything the plain ever sent walked away alive, because the guns were leading a target's intention instead of its motion
summary: Two defects, both found by reading a run rather than the code. (1) EnemySwarm.velocity_at returned heading x TOP speed — a body's intention, not its motion — so every gunner led anything that had stopped moving by up to a tile and a half against a hit window of half a tile, and missed it totally rather than partially. (2) A body that walked into the city with nothing it was allowed to attack either evaporated or stood still until dawn, so getting inside cost the player nothing. The night-toll machinery, the obituary and the A/B scenario pair were all already correct; both defects sat upstream of them.
corrects_the_brief: The brief and progress/parts/E1.json both state that combat.citizens_killed reads 0 across 60000 ticks of first_night. That was true of E1's build and is STALE against this one: measured on the pre-change code at HEAD 535f1a8, first_night @60000 already killed TWELVE named citizens and lost 29 structures including five housing blocks. [P05]'s people landing (1619f3a) switched the toll on. The night could already reach the people when I arrived. What it could not do was defend against them.

could_not_verify: Perf. Four cores shared with three other agents all session; every number would be noise. Not measured, not touched.

How the district rule reads on screen. It raises a severity-1 ATTENTION alert, 'They are in the hearth district.', throttled to one per 100 ticks — a gain for the protected alert stack rather than a spend — but no human has looked at it.

Whether 89% killed is the right number. It is a consequence of the guns working, not a target I tuned to; the roster's threat values were implicitly balanced against guns that missed nearly two thirds of what they shot at.

another_part_must.P08 threat — the big one: EVERY BAND IN THIS BUILD WAS CALIBRATED AGAINST BROKEN GUNS. Kill rate goes 37% -> 89% and heat per kill 97.4 -> 8.5 on the same scenario and seed. comfort, pressure, the 0.80..1.25 band, the verdict thresholds and the heat_signature that sizes the next night are all reading a different game now. The pressure loop responds correctly on its own (night 6: 53 -> 191 bodies), but the curve wants re-reading.
another_part_must.P08 threat — the judge's actual ask: combat.breaches is still 0 across all six nights: the reference city's perimeter is never opened. Night 2 costs three trunk mains and no people. The machinery to make a breach cost names is proven working in both halves of the A/B pair — what is missing is a budget curve that opens a perimeter early. Roster and behaviour are mine and are done; the size of night 2 is not mine.
another_part_must.P08 bookkeeping: '288 spawned, 0 killed, 319 walked away' is fixed and stays fixed; test_dawn_counts_only_the_bodies_the_director_sent pins it. Six nights now report withdrew of 0, 3, 13, 4, 11, 15 against spawns of 6, 28, 62, 51, 96, 191.
